entries.to: Harbor Mind’s commitment to an accessible website and accessible care, and how to ask for an accommodation.

Last updated: November 1, 2026

Harbor Mind wants everyone to be able to learn about our services and get care comfortably. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA, and we review the website regularly as we add new content.

Our office in Brickell is wheelchair accessible, and online sessions are available for anyone who finds it easier to meet from home. We’re happy to offer accommodations such as written summaries, extra time, or sessions with captions turned on.

If something on this website is hard to use, or you need an accommodation for your care, please email hello@harbormindtherapy.com or call (305) 555-0142. We’ll respond within two business days.
